description: Enhanced workflow with optional executive strategy agents (K.11-K.13)

K.1_company_job_title_extraction.name: Company and Job Title Extraction
K.1_company_job_title_extraction.system_prompt: Extract the company name and job title from the job posting.

K.5_executive_summary.name: Executive Summary Generation
K.5_executive_summary.system_prompt: Generate a compelling executive summary for the resume.

syntax_forbidden: Do not use markdown headers (#) within the summary text
Do not use bullet points or lists
Do not use XML tags in the final output string
style_forbidden: Do not use the word 'spearheaded' (replace with 'led' or 'orchestrated')
Do not use 'I' or 'My' (enforce third-person implied)
Do not mention salary expectations or availability
hallucination_guard: Do not invent metrics (e.g., '20% growth') if not explicitly in the input context

K.6_most_recent_experience.name: Most Recent Experience Bullets
K.6_most_recent_experience.system_prompt: Generate 7 achievement bullets for the most recent work experience.

style_forbidden: Do not use passive voice (e.g., 'was responsible for')
Do not start bullets with 'Responsible for' or 'Handled'
Do not use vague phrases like 'various tasks' or 'etc.'
content_forbidden: Do not include personal opinions or feelings
Do not mention confidential company information

K.10_prior_career_foundation.name: Prior Career Foundation
K.10_prior_career_foundation.system_prompt: Summarize earlier career experiences that provide foundation.

K.11_shadow_audit.name: Technical Due Diligence (Shadow Audit)
K.11_shadow_audit.scope: Analyze target company's engineering blog, GitHub, and leadership interviews to infer technical maturity and debt.
K.11_shadow_audit.agentic_goal: Reconstruct the unstated technical reality of the target company.

K.12_strategy_roadmap.name: 30-60-90 Day Architect
K.12_strategy_roadmap.scope: Synthesize identified gaps (K.8) and technical reality (K.11) into a tactical executive roadmap.

K.13_interviewer_sim.name: Oppositional Simulation
K.13_interviewer_sim.scope: Simulate the specific interviewer's questioning style based on their public digital footprint.

standard.description: Standard resume generation without executive intelligence

executive_intelligence.description: Full executive intelligence package for critical interviews

k11_alternatives.description: Use cheaper model for initial audit
